outline: This course introduces the basic programming skills for C programming language. The topics to be covered include programming environment, structured program development, data types, input/output functions, computation and logic operators, control statements, functions, array, pointers, string, structures, file I/O, and dynamic data structures such as linked list and stacks.

(Week 2)       Overview of C

(Week 4)       Top-Down Design with Functions

(Week 7)       Repetition and Loop Statements

(Week 10)      Simple Data Types
(Week 11)      Arrays
(Week 12)      Arrays
(Week 13)      Strings
(Week 14)      Strings
(Week 15)      Structure and Union Types
(Week 16)      Structure and Union Types
(Week 17)      Text and Binary File Processing
(Week 18)      Final Exam
